decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher it remains close to the firm's core postpress know-how and service network, so the firm is likely to keep learning from installed use and retain it unless demand stays clearly below expectations.

The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's existing finishing workflow expertise and fits its automation direction, giving strong absorptive capacity and a good basis for incremental improvement rather than withdrawal.

This folding add-on unit is tightly linked to the installed base and already had a concrete customer application, so it is the least likely of the remaining products to be withdrawn within the next year.
